note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: The invariant differential, the binomial log series, the coefficients of L and the truncation error v(eps) >= 28 are stated. The error bound is stated at every prime p > 324 and every pi | p, more generally than at a contact prime.

snippet.text:
theorem log25_truncation_error {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp324 : 324 < p) {π : Zs} (hπ : Prime π)
    (hπp : π ∣ (p : Zs)) (P : (shortCurve (-genDAt π hπ ^ 2)).toAffine.Point)
    (hP : P ∈ W1 (vComp π hπ) (-genDAt π hπ ^ 2)) (hP0 : P ≠ 0) :
    vComp π hπ (ellLog P) = vComp π hπ (zCoord P) ∧ 1 ≤ vComp π hπ (zCoord P) ∧
      ∃ ε, 28 ≤ vComp π hπ ε ∧
        truncLog (genDAt π hπ ^ 2) (zCoord P) = 16575 * ellLog P * (1 + ε) := by
